description: A test annotation that starts only the beans and auto-configuration of one layer, such as WebMvcTest or DataJpaTest.
An annotation that starts the full application context for an integration test, with a mock web environment by default.
A way to exercise Spring MVC request handling in a test without opening a network port.
A Spring Framework annotation that registers a Mockito mock as a bean in the test context, replacing MockBean.
A starter such as spring-boot-starter-webmvc-test that supplies the test support for one technology in Spring Boot 4.
Spring's reuse of a started application context across test classes that share the same configuration.
An annotation that adds MockMvc to a SpringBootTest, which no longer provides it by default in Spring Boot 4.
